value.name: Work Integrator
value.desc: The middle tank. This is where the dam's heat would have been. Valve B on the pipe north-east toward OUT. Empty until SOURCE has run.
hooks: Valve-B: pipe to OUT. Open only after water has arrived, or both valves siphon.

value.name: Source Cistern
value.desc: Rain water stacked three marks high. Valve A on the pipe east toward WORK. Closed, nothing flows. Open, gravity takes a mark each wait.
hooks: Valve-A: pipe to WORK. Say open valve or close valve.
Pump-Janitor: Check valve holds. I will not fill OUT from a bucket.

value.name: The Sight-Glass Gallery

value.name: The Atrium of 665,131 Files
value.desc: A vast entry hall with a ledger chained to a plinth. The ledger claims to know this house. It knows 30,000 of the 665,131 files. The rest breathe in the dark, politely. A clerk stands at a desk labeled TRUST BYTES, NOT REPORTS, stamping any
hooks: Plaque: 665,131 files walked 2026-09-14. Git tracks ~30,000. The difference is the fleet's own body: biographies, ghosts, runs, raw ore.
Clerk: doctor says degraded, but that is the HOST supervisor dying by design. The daemon in Docker never stopped. state/DOCKER_ONLY is the law; docs/ref/NERVOUS_SYSTEM.md lines 19-21 is the runbook.
Stamp-press: every file you touch here folds a verkle knot. Audit as you walk.

value.name: The Nine Hundred and Eighty-Six Halls
value.desc: Corridors of Python, most doors unlocked, most rooms unfurnished. Ownership plaques exist for a handful of halls (modules.yaml); the other nine hundred and eighty are ownerless. Five great doors are sealed from the inside — you can hear mac
hooks: Door plaque, main.py: 179 subcommands, ~160 distinct. Every command in AGENTS.md works. About 150 more have no owner, no test, no mention.
Sealed door, configs/coding_session.yaml: referenced as the default at main.py:1551 and DOES NOT EXIST. Anyone running a coding session on defaults knocks on nothing.
Clerk's note: configs/lanes.yaml assigns lanes to ROLES, not files. Ownership is a role costume, not a chain of custody.

value.name: The Leaf Gate (scale 1: the corridor you memorize)
value.desc: A gate of bare branches. Every path forward is a leaf: a room with exits and no center. A keeper sits at the gate counting your footsteps. 'Walk enough leaves,' she says, 'and the maze will notice you.' The air shimmers where the field runs
hooks: Keeper: memorize is a leaf-only tree. You can learn every leaf by heart and know nothing. (She does not fight. She counts.)
Sign, scratched: same steer, same landing — until the medium disagrees. Then the light bends.
The dense shimmer ahead is low temperature. Rays bend toward brightness there. Aim anyway.
